audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers agreed on Cassiopeia for all seven rows at a 51.08% win rate, and row 0 claimed your poke 'shuts down Anivia's only engage tool from level 1'.
audit.why: Flash Frost is 1075 range against Noxious Blast's 850 — she out-ranges you at level 1. It is slow, costs 80 mana and is on 11s at rank 1, so dodging it is realistic, but the row is not free.
audit.corrected: Row 0 moved to Skill in both layers with matching why/whys and a 5/10 rating. Rows 1-6 left with Cassiopeia — grounded: no dash on either side, your 0.75s Twin Fang out-DPSes a 4s Frostbite in extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number and pointed at the wrong ability as the danger.
audit.why: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7s, Frostbite a flat 4s, Crystallize a flat 17s, Glacial Storm a 4/3/2s toggle. Crystallize is the ability that actually kills a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in, with Crystallize named as the Flash-worthy threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and mid told you to DPS her through Glacial Storm. That is the one place you must not stand.
audit.why: Riot text on Frostbite: 'If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.' Standing in the storm gives her the same double-damage window as landing her Q.
audit.corrected: Both fields rewritten: fang her from the storm's edge, never from inside it. Crystallize's retreat-cut against a dashless champion added to dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 lint findings: 15 misgendered fields calling Anivia 'he/his/him', 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 cooldowns field with no digit. spikes[2] also invented the ability name 'Egglock'.
audit.why: Anivia is female per champ-gender.js. Her passive is Rebirth; 'Egglock' is not in the kit.
